scope: Synthetic random resident tensors only; no Wan weights, model calls, fitting, input images or video. This is not model registration.
timed_boundary: Common synthetic LayerNorm/AdaLN, Smooth/cast/Q1, all main and auxiliary GEMMs, tanh GELU/Smooth/cast/Q2, pooling/shared-sign sketch/norm/ranking/layout, post-Q2 averaging, affine mean removal, own-row reconstruction, gate and residual addition. Common LayerNorm/AdaLN is a PyTorch stand-in, not a claim of original fused-kernel identity.
fixed_control: Same3958 two-point stripes at fixed first3958 stripe positions; this is a hardware-placement control, not a best-fixed quality policy.
dynamic_arm: Top3958 shared-input contrast squared norms, selected before any W1, same count/operator/precision as fixed arm. No learned selector or conditional-quality claim.
quantizer: Existing native HiF4 BF16 entry for every arm. Verify all8 Q1/Q2 controls against original forceFP32 before timing; stop on mismatch. Synthetic effective W1/W2 quantized once with original HiF4 offline; new affine and R256 use BF16.
timing: One currently idle GPU0 with standard worker lock and environment. Rotate/reverse four-arm timing order; all7 samples saved, CUDA event whole-chain medians and host elapsed samples. No large tensor files.
stop: One frozen comparison, no fusion/rank/layout/precision/seed tuning after measurement. If pooled whole-chain speed is below1.5x dense, close this direct implementation as an immediate deployment option; the unmeasured fused/function family is not globally rejected.
resources: One standard locked GPU, existing environment and quantizer only, random resident buffers below the80GiB device limit, zero model/cache downloads or persistent tensor output.
interpretation: Synthetic full shape is not original160-FFN model timing, model numerical equivalence, selector benefit or video quality. All original model eligibility and closures remain unchanged.
